result.summary: The food delivery home screen has several layout and content issues: a typo in search, truncated category and restaurant names, and overlapping/clipped UI at the bottom.

issues.description: Search placeholder is misspelled as 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge, so the category row looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add peek/overflow affordance or padding so the last visible chip isn't clipped, and ensure horizontal scroll works clearly.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, smaller type, or a two-line title so full names remain readable.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so list content isn't obscured by the tab bar.

issues.description: The notification badge sits slightly outside the bell button circle.
issues.suggestion: Inset the badge so it stays fully within the icon button bounds.
